create_artifact: create an Artifact dataclass instance with uri, name, and artifactObjectType fields
create_artifact_with_tags: create an Artifact dataclass instance with tags, version, and isZipped fields set
use_artifact_object_type_enum: use the ArtifactObjectType enum to specify IMAGE, VIDEO, TEXT, JSON, or other types
create_load_artifact_response: create a LoadArtifactResponse dataclass instance wrapping an Artifact object
create_upload_text_log_response: create an UploadTextLogArtifactResponse dataclass instance with an artifactId string
